statement:
Find all ordered triples $(x, y, z)$ of real numbers satisfying
$$\begin{cases} xy = z - x - y \\ xz = y - x - z \\ yz = x - y - z. \end{cases}$$

How many ways can $8$ mutually non-attacking rooks be placed on a $9 \times 9$ chessboard so that all $8$ rooks are on squares of the same colour? (Two rooks attack each other if they are in the same row or column.)
figure_description: A standard 9×9 chessboard with alternating black and white squares.

statement: Let $A, B, C, D$ be four points on a circle (in clockwise order) with $AB < AD$ and $BC > CD$. The bisectors of angles $\angle BAD$ and $\angle BCD$ meet the circle at $X$ and $Y$, respectively. Consider the hexagon formed by these six points on the circle. If four of the six sides of the hexagon have equal length, prove that $BD$ must be a diameter of the circle.

Let $p$ be an odd prime. Prove that
$$\sum_{k=1}^{p-1} k^{2p-1} \equiv \frac{p(p+1)}{2} \pmod{p^2}.$$

Let $T$ be the set of all positive integer divisors of $2004^{100}$. What is the largest possible number of elements of a subset $S$ of $T$ such that no element of $S$ divides any other element of $S$?
